# JTN Printable

> Original printable gallery-wall collections and room-by-room printable wall-art guides. Digital downloads only; no physical prints or frames are shipped.

## Canonical site
- Primary and canonical public URL: https://jtnprintable.com/

## Foundational collection pages
- [Coastal Cottage Printable Wall Art](https://jtnprintable.com/coastal-cottage-wall-art/): Coastal cottage printable wall art for beach homes, lake houses, and cottages.
- [Tropical Aquarium Bathroom Wall Art Set of 6 | Printable](https://jtnprintable.com/tropical-aquarium-wall-art/): Style a colorful coastal bathroom with a coordinated tropical aquarium wall art set of 6. Instant digital download with 72 JPG files in 12 print sizes.
- [Printable Gallery Wall Sets](https://jtnprintable.com/printable-gallery-wall-sets/): Printable gallery wall sets for coastal cottages, lake houses, colorful ocean spaces, and digital-download decor.
- [Digital Download Help](https://jtnprintable.com/digital-download-help/): How JTN Printable digital downloads work on Etsy.
- [How to Print Printable Wall Art](https://jtnprintable.com/how-to-print-printable-wall-art/): A practical guide to choosing paper, print size, and frames for printable gallery wall art downloaded from Etsy.
